lead: High-pressure cleaning lifts the grime out of your grout that a mop just pushes around.
cardDescription: High-pressure cleaning that lifts grime out of the grout lines, with optional sealing to keep it clean.
homeDescription: Bring back the color that's been hiding in your floors.

whatsIncluded.label: Pre-treat & dwell
whatsIncluded.description: A cleaning solution goes down first to break up grease and soap scum in the grout.

whatsIncluded.label: High-pressure extraction
whatsIncluded.description: A pressurized rinse blasts the grime out of the grout lines and vacuums it away.

whatsIncluded.label: Grout detail work
whatsIncluded.description: Stubborn lines get worked by hand so the whole floor comes out even.

whatsIncluded.label: Optional grout sealing
whatsIncluded.description: A sealer keeps dirt out of the porous grout so it stays clean longer.

faq.a: It'll look dramatically better. Grout that's stained rather than just dirty may not go all the way back to white. I'll tell you before I start.

faq.q: Should I get the grout sealed?
faq.a: If your grout's unsealed, yes. It keeps dirt from soaking back in and makes the clean last much longer.

faq.q: Can you clean shower tile too?
faq.a: Yes, showers, backsplashes, and floors. Vertical tile takes a bit more time but cleans up well.

faq.q: How long until I can walk on it?
faq.a: The floor's walkable within an hour or two. If I seal the grout, give it a full day before heavy traffic.
